messages:
lena_fin: Heads up — Silverpine invoice INV-7841 hit our queue but routed to the Ops approver queue instead of Finance. System flagged missing tax classification and blocked approval. Can someone re-route and confirm tax treatment?
ashwin_ops: Hmm — looks like NetSuite PO mapping returning null for VendorTaxClass. Do we have a PO on this one?
lena_fin: No PO on file, vendor wrote 'N/A' in their PO field. They did include order reference REF-992 but we never map REF->PO.
beth_approvals: @ashwin_ops can you check routing rules? Shouldn't vendor tax class drive the approver when PO is absent?
ashwin_ops: Our rule: if PO missing -> route to Finance; if VendorTaxClass=exempt -> route to Tax team. But when VendorTaxClass is blank the fallback is Ops for legacy vendors. Silverpine slipped through because their vendor-profile lacks taxCode.
sam_gov: Silverpine is an international vendor (IE). Their tax class is usually "out_of_scope" in records but looks like the vendor record in NS is empty. I can update vendor profile but that won't fix this invoice until it's reprocessed.
vendor-bot: Silverpine (accounts@silverpine.io) uploaded invoice INV-7841 (PDF)  — link: https://files.example.com/silverpine/INV-7841.pdf
lena_fin: attaching OCR excerpt: "Total: 12,400.00 EUR
Tax: 0.00
VAT Status: non-EU supply" — so it should be classified as 'out_of_scope' and route to Finance for GL mapping to 6801 (external services).
ashwin_ops: Quick manual fix: run `/route-invoice 1758502468 --to finance-approvals --note "vendor tax class set to out_of_scope; manual re-route"` — someone from Finance needs to pick it up.
beth_approvals: On it. I'll claim and do the approval path. But we also need the vendor to confirm the order reference maps to REF-992. I'll ping them. @vendor-bot please confirm REF-992 is the contract/order number.
vendor-bot: Confirmed. REF-992 = Master SOW 2024-07; billing contact accounts@silverpine.io. PO: none.
sam_gov: FYI if we mark vendor tax class as out_of_scope in NS, future invoices will route correctly. I'll update vendor record now and add comment: "Tax class populated from vendor confirmation 2025-08-21"
finance-bot: Automation note: invoice re-route task created by ashwin_ops (task #T-5582). Audit trail will show manual override.
beth_approvals: Completed preliminary review and coding to GL 6801. Forwarded to approver group Finance-PM for sign-off.
lena_fin: Nice — one more ask: can payments team hold until vendor signs new SOW addendum (they requested net-60). Put a payment hold tag.
ashwin_ops: Done — flagged payment_hold:true on invoice record. Also kicked a re-sync to GL mapping service.
beth_approvals: Approved routed invoice and left note: "Approved after vendor tax class confirmed + GL mapping. Hold payment per request." Marking resolved on my side. :white_check_mark:
lena_fin: Thanks all. I'll follow up with payments to ensure hold respected. Closing thread once payments confirms release state.
finance-bot: Payment team notified (channel: #payments). Next update expected within 24h.
payments_lead (via DM): Confirmed — payment hold acknowledged, will not schedule until SOW addendum received.
lena_fin: Closing — resolved routing, vendor record updated, invoice approved but payment on hold. Thanks! :raised_hands:
